title: Met catalogue sample — places of making
evidence_label_meaning: a record of what an institution states, dated — not an observation and not computed

source.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
source.licence: CC0 1.0 — collection data; commercial use yes; attribution not required (the Met asks users to consider citing)
source.media: excluded — no image or other media is in this file or fetched by the page

credit: Collection data: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access (CC0), source CSV of 2 Nov 2026 (commit e394878)

view.rules: v2 created_at (validate_v2.py); certain, aligned, ISO 3166-1 resolved; superseded wording and "Country of Origin" never place an object
view.description: The Met's catalogued place of making (created_at), mapped to present-day countries; source wording, uncertainty and superseded assertions preserved; not independent historical verification
view.clearance: Phase 0 research-gate clearance accepted 7 Nov 2026 (Chad, after GPT) — not release readiness, not independent verification of every object

sample.population_definition: records with a Geography Type segment that maps to a relationship and a non-empty Country; five departments (Egyptian Art, Islamic Art, The American Wing, Medieval Art, The Cloisters)

counts.heading_rule: the Met's most frequent country text paired with a certain place-of-making wording among that country's objects; each object shows its own full wording

sensitivity.every_object: not fully assessed (keyword screen + 3 page findings only; no manual assessment)
sensitivity.unlabelled: no screen hit; this does NOT mean not sensitive
sensitivity.tentative_labels: from keyword screens and three page findings; tentative; not comprehensive (the Yup'ik ceremonial mask 717572 was found only by page check)
sensitivity.handling: Included with honest context for this metadata-only scope (Chad, 7 Nov 2026); source restrictions preserved; inclusion is not a claim about ownership legitimacy

limitations: 479 objects retained from a seeded 2,000-record sample of 59,137 Met records with typed geography. This filtered view draws from four departments; it does not represent the Met's whole collection or the world's art.
Arts of Africa, Oceania and the Americas is an excluded department, not an absence of those regions.
The Met's catalogued place of making, mapped to present-day countries — a location reference only, not historical nationality.
"Country of Origin" is its own relationship and is kept outside this view; superseded wording ("Formerly considered made in") never places an object. The Met's wording is shown verbatim.
Concentration: United States 239 of 479 (49.9%); 8 countries have one object; 12 have three or fewer.
Random page check: 0 of 27 reached Met pages disagree (95% interval for the error rate 0–12.5%); 23 pages were not reached and are unverified, not passes.
The Met's catalogue, not independent historical verification; the Met says cataloguing is ongoing.
Sensitivity not fully assessed: no object was manually assessed; 11 carry tentative labels; an unlabelled object is not established as not sensitive.
A fixed snapshot: the Met updates its CSV weekly; every figure here is tied to the source CSV of 2 Nov 2026 (commit e394878).
